$comment: Read by the OurStudio SITES preview mode (spec: agent_notes/studio-spec/20260914_sites_preview_mode_spec.md; contract agreed website-developer f28bb754 <-> studio-spec a62261ad, 2026-09-15). The Studio launches `dev` or `static` from this repo root and frames http://localhost:<port><ready_path> once it answers 200. Ports are pinned so the three sites never collide: jk 3100/3101, ink 3200/3201, loe 3300/3301. 2026-09-15 (website-developer 55339aa7): production is the Next App Router (netlify.toml builds `npm run build:next` via @netlify/plugin-nextjs since the 2026-07-21 cutover), so the preview launches Next, not the legacy Vite SPA — the review-mode books at /books exist only in the Next renderer.
name: lawsofexistence.com
notes: Next 16 App Router served by `next start` (SSR host on Netlify; every route prerendered). `next.config.ts` sets allowedDevOrigins for 127.0.0.1 + localhost and forwards browser console errors to the terminal with file:line. The full production build is `npm run build:next` (it pulls Open Readings answers from Netlify Blobs first — network); `npx next build` is the offline equivalent for a preview. The legacy Vite SPA still builds (`npm run build`, `npx vite --port 3300`) but no longer deploys.
